```{r load packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(here)
```

```{r load in and filter data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
homicides <- read.csv(here("data", "homicide-data.csv"))
str(homicides)

homicides <- homicides |> 
  mutate( city = str_to_lower(city))

Omaha_homicides <- homicides |> 
  filter(city == "omaha")

Omaha_homicides <- Omaha_homicides |> 
  mutate(outcome = if_else(disposition == "Closed by arrest", "Solved", "Unsolved"))

```

```{r isolate Omaha for mapping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
omaha_map <- county_subdivisions(county = "Douglas", state = "Nebraska") 

omaha_homicides_2 <- st_as_sf(Omaha_homicides, coords = c("lon", "lat")) |> 
  st_set_crs(4326)

```
 
```{r make map of Omaha homicides, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = omaha_map, color = "lightgray") +
  geom_sf(data = omaha_homicides_2, aes(color = fct_lump(victim_race, n = 3))) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome,
             nrow = 2) +
   scale_color_viridis(name = "Race", discrete = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Omaha Area Homicides") +
  theme_linedraw(ink = "gray28")

```
